basis: Owner, 2026-10-27 ~20:40-22:50 UTC (migration/strategy/DECISIONS.md, 'Owner decision: no stall, Pavo speech kept, free fallbacks for silent shots (2026-10-27)'): keep Pavo's native speech and ambient sound for the spoken shots, judged clip by clip (exact KJV words by ASR with medium.en, one consistent voice per character against its reference clip, lip sync, diction), our Kokoro voice only for a line Pavo's prompt filter refuses, no music from Pavo (our owned track under the cut); Pavo's budget goes first to the spoken shots and, when it runs out, the non-spoken shots are filled from free licensed footage or approved FLUX stills with motion, each approved by Claude >= 9.5. This is story-qa-criteria-v3 with only rights.ai_video.audio changed ('removed' -> kept per clip under checks) and these rows added: speech.asr_model (the pinned ASR: base.en hears 'gavest' as 'gave us', WER 0.105 on a KJV-exact line, PR #473), rights.ai_video.audio_silent_shots, rights.ai_video.speech_checks, rights.ai_video.refused_line_voice, rights.fallback_sources, grammar.ai_video_speech_checks, grammar.spoken_audio_mix and grammar.fallback_shots. Every other row and number is v3's, unchanged (technical, loudness, speech, pace, rights, licence lists, 4-7 s holds, the .srt track, the 9.5 floor and the Claude review); v1, v2 and v3 stay frozen and unchanged. A plan is measured by v4 only when it declares "criteria": "story-qa-criteria-v4"; every other long keeps v3. Frozen before the first v4 render.

technical.video: 2560x1440, H.264, 30 fps, one audio stream (AAC 48 kHz stereo)

asr_model.why: base.en and small.en hear the KJV 'gavest' as 'gave us' on Pavo's speech and on our own Kokoro voice (WER 0.105 on an exact line); medium.en hears it on both (evidence/pavo/20261027/native-audio-probe)

ai_video.audio: pavo speech+ambient kept per clip under checks
ai_video.disclosure: altered or synthetic content on, AI visuals named in the description

speech_checks.applies_to: every Pavo clip that keeps its own speech: a character or the Keeper speaking on camera, God's or the Keeper's voice-over
speech_checks.words: the plan's line (the KJV word for word, kjv_check), lower case, punctuation ignored, by speech.asr_model
speech_checks.voice_encoder: resemblyzer 0.1.4 VoiceEncoder (GE2E): cosine of utterance embeddings on the ASR speech span
speech_checks.voice_reference: the character's reference clip (production/bible/voices.json, by sha256, chosen by Claude's review by PR); a clip of a character with no reference fails
speech_checks.lipsync: an on-camera talking clip passes lipsync_check.py against its own soundtrack (SyncNet gate); a voice-over Keeper clip passes --still-mouth; God's voice-over clip passes --faces with no face

ai_video.refused_line_voice: a line Pavo's prompt filter refuses (PAVO_PROMPT_BLOCKED) is voiced by the pinned Kokoro voice (rights.voice_model_hash_pinned), its clip judged as in v3

fallback_sources.for: every shot whose Pavo clip does not exist or does not fit the budget before the slot, in this order. A silent shot WITH characters on screen only as a Pavo clip, an APPROVED Pavo still made with every approved reference of each character it shows (character_stills), or faceless footage (faceless_footage); a spoken shot keeps Pavo's native clip where one exists and passes, otherwise the pinned Kokoro voice over an approved visual of the shot (no lip-sync is claimed, the speaker's mouth is not shown speaking); God is always the Kokoro voice-over and never a figure
order: pavo_reuse: every existing Pavo asset of the plan (clip, approved still), adopted by sha256 (R1, never regenerated)
pavo: Pavo VIDEO with the characters' references at an exact 0-credit quote, the key beats and spoken shots first
footage: a library clip under rights.allowed_footage_licences, vetting APPROVED, seen by Claude, at the plan's frame; no person, or a faceless figure under faceless_footage

still_motion: an APPROVED still (a Pavo character still under character_stills, at least grammar.image_repeat_gap_seconds_min from its other uses; or a FLUX/SDXL scene frame under rights.allowed_model_licences) in continuous camera motion
voice: the pinned Kokoro voice for every line without a passing native clip; God always Kokoro
fallback_sources.character_stills: made by Pavo agnes-image (rights.ai_video.licence, owner-owned output) with exactly the approved reference images (characters.json refs, by sha256) of every character the shot names, Pavo's read-back showing that many input images; the character's look word for word in the prompt; reviewed >= 9.5 like every still
fallback_sources.each_shot: shows what its line says (the picture follows the words), states the plan's period and names nothing it excludes, carries a character only from such a still, and is approved by Claude's review >= 9.5 (approve-source), never automatically
fallback_sources.licences: rights.allowed_footage_licences and rights.allowed_model_licences, unchanged; a Pavo character still carries rights.ai_video.licence
fallback_sources.faceless_footage: licensed stock video in which no face is visible: hands on a fruit or a branch, bare feet on grass or in a stream, a figure from behind or in silhouette, a robe's hem, leaves, water, a garden at dawn, a fire, an animal; period-coherent (no modern clothing, objects, buildings, jewellery, tattoos or print; ancient-looking robes or bare skin only); it never stands for a named character's face and never for God; the picture follows the line it sits under; vetted and approved >= 9.5 per clip (approve-source)

failure_policy: Any FAIL blocks approval; criteria are not edited after results to pass.
not_claimed: Audience response, CTR, retention or revenue

grammar.first_shot: the acted cold-open conflict: a scene whose spoken line (a character's or God's voice-over) starts within first_word_onset_seconds_max, no title card, never the Keeper (structure script.gate cold_open_s, keeper_in_cold_open false)
grammar.figures_allowed: characters.json entries with status APPROVED, each prompt carrying the look word for word and its approved references (the Keeper only in his own shots), plus anonymous figures seen from behind or in silhouette; no other person, and God never as a figure
grammar.caption_track: uploaded .srt (YouTube closed captions): the script's words on their voice timings
grammar.ai_video_clip_checks: every Pavo clip passes clip_check.py; every talking clip (the Keeper, a character speaking) passes lipsync_check.py; God's voice-over clips pass lipsync_check.py --faces with no face
grammar.ai_video_speech_checks: every Pavo clip that keeps its speech passes rights.ai_video.speech_checks; one that fails is generated again or its line voiced by the pinned Kokoro voice

spoken_audio_mix.per_clip_gain: one static gain per Pavo speech clip to rights.ai_video.speech_checks.clip_voice_lufs_target, at most clip_gain_db_max, no compression
spoken_audio_mix.ambience_bed: one continuous low ambience bed under every cut: no cut drops to digital silence
spoken_audio_mix.music: the owned track only (rights.music_owned_generator_with_hash), ducked under the voice

grammar.fallback_shots: every fallback shot (rights.fallback_sources) is licensed and approved >= 9.5, its source recorded per shot in the manifest; a character's face on screen only from Pavo (a clip, or a still made with its approved references); a faceless figure only from vetted footage; a spoken one only on Pavo's passing native clip or the Kokoro voice

perceptual_review_required_before_approv: Watched review (long_review.watch); owner floor: overall >= 9.5 for new uploads.
